hooks.text: Two continent-sized blobs of a lost planet sit deep beneath our feet.
Did Earth swallow the Mars-sized world that created the Moon?
1,800 miles beneath our feet lie the bruised remains of Theia.

title: The Lost Planet Inside Earth
description: Discover how a Mars-sized world named Theia vaporized the infant Earth and left continent-sized remnants deep inside our mantle.
